### From `packages/core/src/link.ts`

#### <a id="core-adminnotice"></a>`AdminNotice`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/link.ts`

What a system tells its hub's admins (`notifyAdmins`): a short title and a plain-words body.

```ts
type AdminNotice = {
  title: string;
  body: string;
};
```

#### <a id="core-hello"></a>`Hello`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/link.ts`

The first call from a system. A new name starts pairing; a known name gets a challenge.

```ts
type Hello = {
  protocol: 1;
  name: SystemName;
  version: string;
  instance: InstanceName;
  boot: string;
  publicKey: string;
  manifestHash: string;
  instances?: "one" | "many" | undefined;
  contractHash?: string | undefined;
  pairingToken?: string | undefined;
  autoPair?: {
    secret: string;
    id: string;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-linksession"></a>`LinkSession`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/link.ts`

#### <a id="core-runcontrol"></a>`RunControl`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/link.ts`

Cancel or pause a run. The hub sends it to the system running the run; a system sends it for its own child calls.

```ts
type RunControl = {
  run: string;
  action: "cancel" | "pause";
};
```

#### <a id="core-runrequest"></a>`RunRequest`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/link.ts`

The hub's request to run a fn.

```ts
type RunRequest = {
  run: {
    id: string;
    fn: `${string}/${string}`;
    turn: string;
    user: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      email: string;
      role: "admin" | "member";
      groups: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
      }[];
      timeZone: string;
      locale: string;
    };
    time: {
      now: number;
      timeZone: string;
      local: string;
    };
    system: {
      name: string;
      instance: InstanceName;
      boot: string;
      from?: {
        system: string;
        fn: `${string}/${string}`;
        run: string;
      } | undefined;
    };
    caller: string;
    attempt: number;
    priority: "background" | "urgent" | "interactive" | "normal";
    parent?: string | undefined;
    session?: string | undefined;
    watched?: boolean | undefined;
  };
  fn: string;
  kind: `${string}/${string}` | "native";
  args: z.core.util.JSONType;
  budget: {
    cost: number;
    time: number;
    limitedBy: string;
  };
  handlers: string[];
  deadline: number;
  configVersion: number;
  payload?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  resume?: {
    state: z.core.util.JSONType;
    calls: Record<string, {
      status: "done";
      result: z.core.util.JSONType;
    } | {
      status: "failed";
      error: {
        class: "retry" | "caller" | "fatal";
        message: string;
        code?: string | undefined;
        data?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
      };
    } | {
      status: "cancelled";
      error?: {
        class: "retry" | "caller" | "fatal";
        message: string;
        code?: string | undefined;
        data?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
      } | undefined;
    } | {
      status: "background";
      run: string;
    }>;
    reason: "restart" | "resumed";
  } | undefined;
  connection?: {
    id: string;
    owner: string;
    credentials: z.core.util.JSONType;
    settings: z.core.util.JSONType;
  } | undefined;
  approved?: {
    by: string;
    preview: {
      title: string;

        type: "text";

      } | {
        type: "code";
        language: string;
        code: string;
        title?: string | undefined;
      } | {
        type: "table";
        title: string;
        table: {
          columns: {
            name: string;
            kind: "number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary";
            nullable: boolean;
            label?: string | undefined;
            type?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
            ref?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
            role?: "group" | "measure" | "attribute" | undefined;
            key?: boolean | undefined;
            editable?: boolean | undefined;
          }[];
          rows: z.core.util.JSONType[][];
          offset: number;
          truncated: boolean;
          sort: {
            column: string;
            dir: "asc" | "desc";
          }[];
          limit?: number | undefined;
          total?: number | undefined;
          write?: {
            affected: number;
          } | undefined;
          records?: {
            type: `${string}/${string}`;
            id: string;
          } | undefined;
          drill?: {
            fn: `${string}/${string}`;
            args: Record<string, z.core.util.JSONType>;
            keys: string[];
          } | undefined;
        };
      } | {
        type: "type-diff";
        name: string;
        changes: string[];
        breaks: {
          fn: string;
          why: string;
        }[];
        before?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
        after?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
      } | {
        type: "flags";
        flags: {
          path: string;
          kind: "token" | "key" | "gitignored" | "env" | "credential" | "secret-content" | "runs-code" | "unknown-path";
          rule: string;
          access: "read" | "write";
          action: "ask" | "allow" | "refuse";
          why: string;
          certain: boolean;
        }[];
      })[];
      irreversible: boolean;
      subject?: {
        kind: "system-install";
        system: SystemName;
        instance: InstanceName;
        version: string;
        manifestHash: string;
        bundleHash: string;
        sourceHash: string;
        host: {
          system: SystemName;
          instance: InstanceName;
        };
        source?: string | undefined;
        grants?: {
          hub: ("search" | "embed" | "fns" | "settings" | "state" | "resources" | "approvals" | "connections" | "decide" | "data" | "ai")[];
          models?: {
            roles?: ("ocr" | "chat" | "transcribe" | "dictate" | "speak" | "describe" | "decide")[] | undefined;
            models?: string[] | undefined;
            perRun?: number | undefined;
            perDay?: number | undefined;
          } | undefined;
          secrets?: string[] | undefined;
          calls?: (`${string}/${string}` | SystemName)[] | undefined;
          network?: string[] | undefined;
          files?: {
            read: string[];
            write: string[];
          } | undefined;
        } | undefined;
        replaces?: {
          version: string;
          manifestHash: string;
        } | undefined;
      } | undefined;
      checks?: {
        scan: {
          size: number;
          builtins: string[];
          concerns: {
            kind: "builtin" | "dynamic-import" | "dynamic-require" | "eval" | "new-function";
            line: number;
            detail: string;
            code: string;
          }[];
          urls: string[];
          hosts: string[];
        };
        tests?: {
          system: SystemName;
          version: string;
          ranAt: number;
          duration: number;
          passed: number;
          failed: number;
          skipped: number;
          cases: {
            file: string;
            name: string;
            status: "failed" | "skipped" | "passed";
            duration: number;
            real?: boolean | undefined;
            error?: string | undefined;
          }[];
          more?: number | undefined;
          previews?: {
            component: string;
            state: string;
            viewport: "phone" | "desktop";
            theme: "light" | "dark";
            image: {
              hash: string;
              size: number;
              mime: string;
            };
          }[] | undefined;
        } | undefined;
      } | undefined;
      summary?: {
        line: string;
        counts: {
          section: string;
          added: number;
          changed: number;
          removed: number;
        }[];
        flags: {
          flag: "models" | "capabilities" | "secrets" | "effects" | "calls" | "files" | "hosts" | "delete-fns" | "write-fns";
          line: string;
          items: string[];
          lead?: string | undefined;
          tail?: string | undefined;
        }[];
        grants?: "added" | "changed" | "widened" | "narrowed" | undefined;
```
